title: Great for First Time Parents
body: Loved this book. It really helped me understand what choices are available and what impacts they have on your baby. I especially appreciated when the data was unclear or there was no settled guidance. Oster presented both sides and allowed the reader to make their own decisions.

body: This is the book I've been waiting for! Amazing science, clearly written for the lay person. Thank you for this gift, perfect for all the new families I work with.

title: The best book for new parents!
body: Having a baby is a schock to your system and this book makes it easier to learn the baby basics. It is fully illustrated, straight to the point and a pleasure to read. I highly recommend!
